correctness.rationale: Exact simplex subtraction yields the covariance eigenvalues and determinant for the stated full-dimensional parameter range. Exact rational simplex integrations confirm all covariance entries in 12 separate polytope decompositions. Finite checks are corroboration, not the infinite proof.
